title: Leviticus Bible Quiz - Chapter 15
description: Ten questions on Leviticus 15: the laws of uncleanness caused by bodily discharges and how a person is cleansed.

questions.text: According to the law, when is a man's discharge his uncleanness?
questions.explanation: Whether his body runs with his discharge, or his body has stopped from his discharge, it is his uncleanness.

answers.text: Only while it is still running
Both when it runs and when it has stopped
Only on the first day it appears
Only after a priest has examined it

questions.text: What must a clean person do if a man with a discharge spits on him?
questions.explanation: He shall wash his clothes, bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

answers.text: Offer a year old lamb as a sin offering
Stay outside the camp for seven full days
Shave off all the hair of his head and beard
Wash his clothes, bathe, and be unclean until evening

questions.text: Which item is named as unclean when a man with a discharge rides on it?
questions.explanation: Whatever saddle he who has the discharge rides on shall be unclean.

answers.text: A saddle
A chariot
A cart
A boat

questions.text: What should a man with a discharge have done before touching someone, so as not to make them unclean?
questions.explanation: Whomever he touches without having rinsed his hands in water must wash his clothes, bathe, and be unclean until evening.

answers.text: Covered his upper lip
Torn his clothes
Rinsed his hands in water
Called the priest

questions.text: What must be done with a wooden vessel that the man with a discharge touches?
questions.explanation: The earthen vessel he touches shall be broken, and every vessel of wood shall be rinsed in water.

answers.text: It must be rinsed in water
It must be broken
It must be burned
It must be buried

questions.text: In what kind of water does a man bathe after counting seven days for his cleansing?
questions.explanation: When he is cleansed of his discharge he counts seven days, washes his clothes and bathes his flesh in running water.

answers.text: Water from a cistern
Water mixed with ashes
Running water
Water from the basin of the tabernacle

questions.text: What does he bring to the priest on the eighth day?
questions.explanation: On the eighth day he takes two turtledoves or two young pigeons to the door of the Tent of Meeting and gives them to the priest.

answers.text: A year old lamb for a burnt offering
A young bull from the herd
A tenth of an ephah of fine flour
Two turtledoves or two young pigeons

questions.text: How long is a woman in her impurity when her discharge is blood?
questions.explanation: If a woman has a discharge and it is blood, she shall be in her impurity seven days.

answers.text: Three days
Seven days
Fourteen days
Thirty days

questions.text: How are the days of a woman's discharge outside the time of her period treated?
questions.explanation: All the days of such a discharge shall be as in the days of her period. She is unclean.

answers.text: As the days of her period
As if she were clean
As the days after childbirth
As the days of a leper

questions.text: Why must the children of Israel be separated from their uncleanness?
questions.explanation: So they will not die in their uncleanness when they defile Yahweh's tabernacle that is among them.

answers.text: So they can enter the land of Canaan quickly
So the priests will have less work to do
So the nations around them will respect them
So they will not die when they defile Yahweh's tabernacle
